(defn greet
  "Greets name times times."
  [name &opt times]
  (default times 1)
  (string/repeat (string "Hello, " name "!\n") times))

(def config {:name "world" :times 2})
(each n [1 2 3]
  (when (> n 1)
    (print (greet (config :name) n))))
